Application Data.NAME: Acme Electrical Supplies Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Electrical Supplies Inc. specializes in the wholesale distribution of electrical equipment and supplies, including lighting fixtures, circuit breakers, wiring, and safety equipment. Our operations involve sourcing products from established manufacturers and supplying them to contractors, retailers, and industrial clients. We maintain a robust inventory management system and prioritize safety in our warehouses to minimize risks. Our sales model includes a growing online platform, constituting approximately 40% of total revenue, which facilitates customer access and enhances service delivery. We focus on efficient logistics and timely deliveries while adhering to industry safety standards and regulations.
